title: DOE, oil firms urged to fully implement fuel price rollback

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Energy and oil companies should fully implement a fuel price rollback of up to double digits per liter, something that a solon described Wednesday as “rare and significant”. 1-Rider Party-list Representative Rodge Gutierrez made this call following reports of incomplete compliance at some stations. “Good news for motorists comes only once in a while — hopefully it will be complied with!” Gutierrez said in a statement.
